column5: 208 cases of the cx.stream readers and writers (cx/stream/rw.cx) and xs_receipt64: xs_reader_fd, xs_reader_mem, xs_read, xs_read_full (-EPIPE on an early end), xs_read_line (LF, CRLF, last line without newline, -EMSGSIZE never truncated, max 0), xs_reader_count, xs_reader_close, xs_writer_fd (buffering, order, close flushes, -ENOSPC breaks the writer and close still releases), xs_writer_buf (limit, all or nothing), xs_write, xs_flush, xs_writer_count, xs_writer_close, xs_copy (limit below zero, exact, one over), xs_pipe_pair (owned fds, no fd leak when a table is full), xs_reader_deadline and xs_writer_deadline refused with -ENOSYS; handles closed, stale after slot reuse, of the wrong kind, table full (-EMFILE), double close; n == 0 and n < 0; guard bytes behind every read.
